**OXI E16**
- **Two layouts:** **16 channels**, one encoder each, as before; or **channel strips**, one column per channel: send A level, send B level, pan, and main level, top to bottom. Choose the layout in **Settings… → Connections** or switch the layout and step the sends on the E16 with Shift. - **Push and turn jumps** to the next stop: −∞, 0 dB, or +6 dB for a level or send; hard left, center, or hard right for a pan. This replaces 1.1.1's push and turn (pan in LEVEL and SEND modes, level in PAN mode). - **Pans stop at center**, however fast they turn; pause, then turn on to pass it. - **The screen** shows each channel's values, marks a muted or PFL'd channel's name, and can show a meter under each name. Meters need TotalMix FX's **Send Level Data** on (Options → Mixer Settings… (F3) → OSC); leave **Peak Hold** off, or the meters move slowly. - **Shift page:** the button in use pulses, and the screen inverts the mode and layout in use. In LEVEL or PAN mode, **< SEND >** steps to the previous or next output, as in SEND mode. - **Fixes:** a PFL on another page now shows in the title; a Shift-page arrow that reaches the last page or send stays lit until released.
**Hidden channels:** a channel hidden or shown in TotalMix FX now appears or disappears on the hardware controller by itself, when you switch away from TotalMix FX or within half a minute; the menu's **Update Hidden Channels** (formerly Refresh Channels from TotalMix FX) does it at once.
**Roto-Control:** meters follow TotalMix FX's fader scale, so quiet levels show lower than before; a pan knob's center stop now reads C in TotalMix FX (it read L01).
**Internal:** shared send rows (`SendRows`), one meter scale (`MeterScale`), names shortened as a set (`fitSet`); device tests 8–11 in `docs/OXI-E16.md`; new `sbdev e16bridge` options.

**OXI E16:** a channel that is muted or in PFL now shows four lights turning on an otherwise dark ring, orange for mute and pink for PFL (eight, alternating, when both are on), so a switch can't be mistaken for a level. While TotalMix FX's Mute Master is off, a muted channel's orange lights stand still and alternate with its level. A level or send now fills its ring at 0 dB and above. Push and turn an encoder to pan in LEVEL and SEND modes, or to set the level in PAN mode; start turning within a second of pushing, and the push neither mutes nor switches PFL. Pans now show red as soon as they move off center.
**Internal:** the E16's per-LED message (test 5), push and turn (test 6), and 1.1.1 on the device (test 7) in `docs/OXI-E16.md`; `sbdev e16 led`, `sbdev e16 shapes`, and `sbdev e16 colors`.

**OXI E16:** Performance Bridge now drives OXI Instruments' E16 (firmware 1.3.0 or later) in its Remote Mode. Sixteen channels at once, one encoder each: turn for level, pan, or a send; press for mute; hold for PFL. Hold Shift to choose the mode, the send's output, and the page. The screen names the channels, and each ring shows its channel's color and level.
**Settings:** a Brightness slider for the E16's rings, on the Connections tab, from 1 to 100.
**Controls Guide and Setup Guide:** a page and a step for the E16; each guide's title now names the maker.
**Internal:** the `OXIE16` library and `E16Driver`; `docs/OXI-E16.md` with the protocol and the test records; `sbdev e16` and `sbdev e16bridge`.

**Controls Guide:** a photo of each hardware controller, a menu to choose the controller shown, and every control, button, and button combination of the Roto-Control in tables. Each guide stands alone.
**Fixes:** the guide's text corrected against the device tests (the Roto-Control's send knobs have no indent; a knob is held while touched or turning; what the Outputs list leaves out).

# Performance Bridge 1.0.3
## New
- **Controls Guide…** in Performance Bridge's menu shows what each control of your hardware controller does. - **Settings… → Channel Layout:** click the pencil beside a name to edit its label, or the **x** beside a label to clear it. - A note under the Sources list explains why playbacks show as "PB 1/2" and so on.

# Performance Bridge 1.0.2
## New
- **A new Setup Guide.** It shows one step per page, with Back and Continue, and a row of marks across the top for every step. It opens at the first step that isn't done. Every page has a screenshot of the window where the setting is, with the setting outlined. A finished page can still show its instructions: click **Show Instructions**. - **Performance Bridge finds your hardware controller.** If the controller chosen in Settings isn't plugged in and exactly one other is, Performance Bridge switches to it by itself. It stops once a controller has connected, or once you click Apply in Settings. - **The Novation button** on a Launch Control brings TotalMix FX to the front. Press it again to go back to the app you were in. - **Mute and PFL on a Launch Control** now say so on its screen ("Mute on", "PFL off", and so on), as well as on the button. - **Mutes flash while TotalMix FX's Mute Master is off,** on the Roto-Control as on a Launch Control. Such a mute is only set and doesn't silence the channel until Mute Master is turned on. - **Clearer buttons on a Launch Control.** A button that is off is dimmer than before, so on and off are easier to tell apart.
## Changes
- **Shift + turn on a send** (Launch Control) says on that encoder's screen how to bring the send back: release Shift, then Shift + turn again. - **Settings… → Connections:** the settings that Apply covers are boxed with its buttons, and the port fields are named as TotalMix FX names them. - **Settings… → Channel Layout:** the Outputs list shows only the outputs the send controls can feed, and a pencil appears beside a channel's name when the pointer is over it. - The meters step is shown only for the Roto-Control: the Launch Controls have no meters.

# Performance Bridge 1.0.1
## New
- **Send rows on the Launch Control XL 3 and Launch Control 3 are easier to tell apart.** A send row whose output has no color in TotalMix FX now lights teal (a blue-green) on the top row and magenta on the middle row, instead of the same green or blue for every such output. An output with a color in TotalMix FX keeps its color. - **Show levels by brightness** (Settings… → Connections, below the send rows; off by default). Level and send encoders dim smoothly with their levels and go dark at −oo. Pan encoders keep full brightness. The XL 3's faders have no lights, so on the XL 3 this shows the send levels.
